fact: Institut Pasteur de Bangui announced on 1 August 2024 the four-year MEDICINE project to build AI-assisted fever diagnostic tools for health centres and community health workers, starting with an exploratory phase.

MSF reports that, with the health authorities, it equipped Batangafo district hospital in 2024 with CAD4TB, an AI tool that scores chest X-rays and sends high-score patients to laboratory confirmation.
MSF reports that in 2025 CAD4TB helped detect 90 of the 203 TB cases screened in the Batangafo area.

The Union and EPCON built an AI model predicting TB positivity on 100 m grids in Bangui with the national TB programme, whose manager says the mapping helped strengthen active screening; the partners plan to validate it with the health ministry before embedding it in national strategies.
